Buch 4 von 16: The Primal Hunter
Beim Laden dieser Seite ist leider ein Problem aufgetreten. Bitte versuche es erneut.
Alle Sprachen und Ausgaben ansehen
Now in D-grade, Jake prepares to face even stronger foes: poo-flinging monkeys, even bigger mushrooms, and the most dreaded of all: politics…

The first World Congress approaches, allowing all the forces on Earth to finally meet, reuniting friends and enemies alike. Of course, to Jake, this World Congress is just a good way to finally catch up with old friends as he lets others deal with all the annoying politics, trying to not get involved.

Unless he wants something, that is.

The World Congress reveals more opportunities in the future for Jake and the other denizens of Earth to take part in, making them all begin their own preparations. To make sure Jake is up to the challenge, he must find stronger prey to get those sweet, sweet levels under his belt. Luckily for him, the death of a hated mushroom revealed a prime hunting ground: A Dungeon.

Book 4 of the hit Primal Hunter LitRPG series is here. Grab your copy today!

About the Series: Experience an Apocalypse LitRPG with levels, classes, professions, skills, dungeons, loot, and all of the great traits of progression fantasy and LitRPG that you've come to expect. Follow Jake as he explores this new vast multiverse filled with challenges and opportunities. As he grows in power and slowly transforms from a bored office worker to a true apex hunter.

So funktionieren Kundenrezensionen und -bewertungen

Um die Gesamtbewertung der Sterne und die prozentuale Aufschlüsselung nach Sternen zu berechnen, verwenden wir keinen einfachen Durchschnitt. Stattdessen berücksichtigt unser System beispielsweise, wie aktuell eine Bewertung ist und ob der Prüfer den Artikel bei Amazon gekauft hat. Es wurden auch Bewertungen analysiert, um die Vertrauenswürdigkeit zu überprüfen.

    I'm very much enjoying the series, even if the long-windedness still persists. Sometimes annoying, but sometimes actually relaxing :)

    That said - I hate monkeys. I still am very amused about the mushroom business. And I really liked that some family reunions took place and am looking forward to more! A lot went on in this book, and it was a great trip along with the main character and the others.

    Looking forward to the next one!

    Solltet Ihr das Genre lieben und diese Bücher noch nicht gelesen haben, macht es! Der MC ist ein echter Antiheld, der nur hier brillieren kann, das Setting ist komplett genrekonform, die Erdintegration in das neue Multiversum “realistisch“. Ich habe die Bücher in Erwartung des nächsten Bandes zum fünften mal gelesen! Ab hier gilt der SPOILERALERT! Die Falken sind der absolute Hit, der Gott ist meine Art von Gott: gut, weil er alles gut kann - nicht aufgrund moralischer Restriktionen. Den Stern Abzug gibt es nur aufgrund des Tigergenozids, der zum Charakterverständnis des zweiten MCs vielleicht nötig war - aber es sind (Gross-)Katzen 😥😢

    Another amazing adventure with Jake as he levels and explores the new system Earth. We also get to see a bit of expansion on our other favorites as well as new characters. Coupled with ever expanding lore as the 93rd universe comes "online" with an excellent balance of adventure, mystery, and world building. It is especially nice to see a good balance of personality in the characters. MCs in these stories usually follow the trope of a bland deus ex machina with a plan or power for everything and no real character traits or just an idiot who falls ack bassword into and out of situations. Jake feels overpowered sometimes because he is, but he works hard to get there and even harder to find the fights where he is not. He does stupid stuff sometimes because we all do dumb stuff occasionally, and he both realizes this and suffers the consequences. Several side characters also make their own realizations and mistakes instead of just being props for the MC or main cast. It makes the world more like a breathing entity than a setting. Excited to see what comes next.
